deployments_detail.use: Etherlink AI networking platforms (Ethernet fabrics for AI training/inference) + EOS/CloudVision AI-optimized software; 1.6T portfolio for rack-scale AI

Meta deployed the Arista 7700R4 Distributed Etherlink Switch (DES) as the backend Ethernet fabric for its large-scale AI training clusters, co-developed with Meta to interconnect tens of thousands of 400G-attached XPUs at 800G. [Arista 7700R4 Distributed Etherlink Switch (Meta customer)]
deployments_detail.value: supports tens of thousands of 400G-attached XPUs; 800G interconnects

deployments_detail.use: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure runs its growing AI infrastructure on Arista switches and adopts Arista's EOS Smart AI Suite Cluster Load Balancing (CLB), an RDMA-aware Ethernet load-balancing mechanism that spreads AI flows to keep tail latency low across the GPU cluster fabric. [Arista EOS Smart AI Suite / Cluster Load Balancing (Oracle customer)]

Magnite deployed a dense 800G AI spine built on the modular Arista 7800R4 platform with AI-optimized linecards to support AI/compute data-center workloads. [Arista 7800R4 800GbE platform (Magnite customer)]
deployments_detail.value: up to 576 ports of 800GbE per system

deployments_detail.use: Arista and NVIDIA developed an EOS-based remote AI agent that extends Arista's network OS onto NVIDIA BlueField-3 SuperNICs/servers, giving a single point of control to configure, monitor and QoS-coordinate the compute and network sides of an AI cluster. Shown as a technology demonstration. [Arista EOS remote AI agent on NVIDIA BlueField-3]

AI job-centric observability in CloudVision Universal Network Observability (CV UNO) correlates network data and AI job metrics to optimize AI job performance and pinpoint bottlenecks/hardware issues affecting AI workloads. NOTE: cited NetworkWorld source does NOT support the '100-microsecond interval', 'AI Analyzer' or 'Network Data Lake' specifics in the original claim. [Arista CloudVision UNO (AI job-centric observability)]

Autonomous Virtual Assist (AVA) added to CloudVision as an AI-based network-operations assistant that ingests EOS, NetDL and CloudVision data to detect anomalies and provide proactive operational insights, with agentic autonomous-action capabilities planned; scheduled for Q1 2026 release. [Arista AVA (CloudVision network-operations assistant)]

Arista NDR (Network Detection and Response) uses the AVA (Autonomous Virtual Assist) engine — supervised/unsupervised ML, deep neural networks, belief propagation, clustering and outlier detection — to model entity behavior and detect/respond to network threats with reduced false positives. [Arista AVA (Autonomous Virtual Assist) NDR]

CloudVision AGNI (Arista Guardian for Network Identity) is a cloud-native, AI/ML-driven network access control and identity service providing automated device discovery, profiling, classification and behavioral network visibility across campus/enterprise; generally available. [Arista CloudVision AGNI (ML/AI)]

Arista Edge Threat Management for VeloCloud SD-WAN adds AI-driven zero-trust security to the WAN edge, using AVA for AI-powered policy intelligence including a 'Policy Explainer' and 'Traffic Simulation' to simplify and predict security-policy impact. [Arista AVA / Edge Threat Management for VeloCloud SD-WAN]
